The '''runner snake''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Snake/Legends|snake]] that lived in the swamps of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Parella Jiramma Baco|Parella]] journeyed to Lowick on a quest to locate the [[Unidentified Goracg artist|last member]] of the [[Gorach]] species, and he had his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] drones bomb the world's swamps, in an attempt to drive out the creature. A number of runner snakes subsequently fled from the [[Fire/Legends|flames]] that were ignited by the bombing.
